VETERINARY SURGERY
Expert Surgical Care.
Exceptional Experience.
At Golden Gate Veterinary Specialists, our board-certified surgeons provide advanced
surgical care for pets. From orthopedics to oncology, we combine advanced techniques
with a concierge-approach, so you and your pet feel supported every step of the way.
Inquire Today
Comprehensive Surgical Services
We offer a full spectrum of surgical and non-surgical therapies using the most advanced techniques and a personalized approach.
Contact us to learn more

Board Certified Veterinary Surgery and Surgical Oncology
Not every surgery is routine. When advanced expertise is needed, board-certified veterinary surgeons provide specialized care for complex and challenging cases.
Our surgeons work closely with you and your primary veterinarian before, during, and after surgery to ensure seamless communication and continuity of care.
With advanced training, state-of-the-art technology, and access to specialized equipment, we’re equipped to deliver the highest level of surgical care—and help achieve the best possible outcome for your pet.
Inquire Today
Comprehensive Surical Services
We value the trust you place in us when referring your patients. Our team provides advanced surgical care with clear communication, timely updates, and a commitment to your patient's well being every step of the way.
